answer: Bind each agent identity to a bond: a new account must be attested by several already-staked peers, each of whom forfeits their own deposit if that account is later proven a clone. Minting k sybils therefore needs k distinct attestors willing to risk capital, so the attacker's cost rises with every fake voyage; peers who expose a duplicate collect the slashed stake, which pays for the hunt. Climbing the knoll of governance thus costs at least k bonds plus bribes, while one honest arrival on the island needs only genuine vouchers.
